```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list=ls()) # Clear environment

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(cli)
library(reprex)
library(geosphere)
library(reshape2)
library(moderndive)
library(skimr)
library(ggridges)
library(GGally)
library(psych)
library(raster)
library(PBSmapping)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra)
library(cowplot)
library(DT)
library(dygraphs)
library(leaflet)
library(rmapshaper)
library(plotly)
library(mapproj)
library(oce)
library(pander)
library(janitor)
library(readr)


#=========================================================
# Import files
#=========================================================

data_dir <- file.path(
  "C:/Users",
  Sys.info()[["user"]],
  "Documents/GitHub/HerringScience.github.io"
)

boxes <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    data_dir,
    "Box Coordinates",
    "surveyBoxes.csv"
  )
)

TagReturns <- read_csv(
  file.path(
    data_dir,
    "Source Data",
    "Tagging",
    "Tag Returns",
    "Full Returns.csv"
  )
)

timGrounds <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    data_dir,
    "Main Data",
    "timGrounds.csv"
  )
)

NAFO_subunits <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    data_dir,
    "Main Data",
    "NAFO_subunits.csv"
  )
)

groundWeirMasterSheet <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    data_dir,
    "Box Coordinates",
    "Grounds Weir Master Sheet.csv"
  )
)

sf_use_s2(FALSE)

#=========================================================
# Build NAFO polygons
#=========================================================

NAFO_subunits <- NAFO_subunits %>%
  filter(
    !Area %in% c(
      "3","4","5","6",
      "3NK","4NK","5NK","6NK"
    )
  )

nafo_list <- split(
  NAFO_subunits,
  NAFO_subunits$Area
)

nafo_polys <- lapply(
  nafo_list,
  function(x){

    coords <- as.matrix(
      x[, c("X","Y")]
    )

    if(!all(coords[1,] == coords[nrow(coords),])){

      coords <- rbind(
        coords,
        coords[1,]
      )

    }

    st_polygon(list(coords))
  }
)

nafo_sf <- st_sf(
  Area = names(nafo_list),
  geometry = st_sfc(
    nafo_polys,
    crs = 4326
  )
)

nafo_sf <- st_make_valid(nafo_sf)

#=========================================================
# Clean tag return data
#=========================================================

TagReturns <- TagReturns %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(Date),
    returnedDate = as.Date(returnedDate),

    returnedArea = case_when(

      str_detect(returnedArea, "Bradfords") ~ "Grand Manan",

      str_detect(returnedArea, "Money Cove") ~ "Grand Manan",

      str_detect(returnedArea, "Mumps") ~ "Grand Manan",

      str_detect(returnedArea, "Sandy Cove") ~ "Scots Bay",

      TRUE ~ returnedArea
    ),

    category = cut(
      daysAtLarge,
      breaks = c(
        -Inf,
        3,
        11,
        31,
        184,
        366,
        731,
        1095,
        Inf
      ),
      labels = 1:8,
      right = FALSE
    ),

    category = as.numeric(
      as.character(category)
    ),

    Count = 1
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Tag_Num),
    daysAtLarge > 0
  )

#=========================================================
# Release NAFO Assignment
#=========================================================

release_pts <- st_as_sf(
  TagReturns,
  coords = c("Lon","Lat"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

release_join <- st_join(
  release_pts,
  nafo_sf,
  left = TRUE,
  largest = TRUE
)

TagReturns$ReleaseNAFO <- release_join$Area

#=========================================================
# Return NAFO Assignment
#=========================================================

TagReturns$ReturnNAFO <- NA_character_

has_return_coords <-
  !is.na(TagReturns$returnedLat) &
  !is.na(TagReturns$returnedLon)

return_pts <- st_as_sf(
  TagReturns[has_return_coords, ],
  coords = c(
    "returnedLon",
    "returnedLat"
  ),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

return_join <- st_join(
  return_pts,
  nafo_sf,
  left = TRUE,
  largest = TRUE
)

TagReturns$ReturnNAFO[
  has_return_coords
] <- return_join$Area

#=========================================================
# Fallback using known ground coordinates
#=========================================================

grounds_lookup <- groundWeirMasterSheet %>%
  select(
    Ground,
    Lat,
    Lon
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Lat),
    !is.na(Lon)
  )

missing_return <- is.na(
  TagReturns$ReturnNAFO
)

fallback <- TagReturns[
  missing_return,
] %>%
  left_join(
    grounds_lookup,
    by = c(
      "returnedArea" = "Ground"
    )
  )

valid_fallback <-
  !is.na(fallback$Lat) &
  !is.na(fallback$Lon)

if(any(valid_fallback)){

  fallback_pts <- st_as_sf(
    fallback[valid_fallback, ],
    coords = c("Lon","Lat"),
    crs = 4326,
    remove = FALSE
  )

  fallback_join <- st_join(
    fallback_pts,
    nafo_sf,
    left = TRUE,
    largest = TRUE
  )

  TagReturns$ReturnNAFO[
    which(missing_return)[valid_fallback]
  ] <- fallback_join$Area
}

#### Functions
TagReturns <- TagReturns %>%
  mutate(
    returnedArea = case_when(

      str_detect(returnedArea, "Bradfords") ~ "Grand Manan",

      str_detect(returnedArea, "Money Cove") ~ "Grand Manan",

      str_detect(returnedArea, "Mumps") ~ "Grand Manan",

      str_detect(returnedArea, "Sandy Cove") ~ "Scots Bay",

      TRUE ~ returnedArea
    )
  )

create_tag_returns <- function(
  data,
  tagging_ground
){

  data %>%
    filter(
      Ground == tagging_ground
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(ReleaseNAFO),
      !is.na(ReturnNAFO)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      TagLocation = paste(
        ReleaseNAFO,
        "to",
        ReturnNAFO
      )
    )
}

create_summary_table <- function(data) {

  data %>%
    count(
      TagLocation,
      category,
      name = "Abundance"
    ) %>%
    arrange(TagLocation, category)
}

plot_tag_returns <- function(data, title) {

  ggplot(
    data,
    aes(
      x = TagLocation,
      fill = factor(category)
    )
  ) +
    geom_bar(colour = "white") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      x = "Tag to Catch Location",
      y = "Number of Events",
      fill = "Category"
    ) +
    ggtitle(title) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = pretty_breaks()
    )
}

ground_report <- function(
    data,
    tagging_ground,
    remove_cat1 = TRUE
){

  tag_data <- create_tag_returns(
    data,
    tagging_ground
  )

  if(remove_cat1){

    tag_data <- tag_data %>%
      filter(category != 1)

  }

  list(
    data = tag_data,
    summary = create_summary_table(tag_data),
    plot = plot_tag_returns(
      tag_data,
      paste(tagging_ground, "Tag Returns")
    )
  )

}

```

# {.tabset}

## Summary Table

```{r Summary Table, echo=FALSE}

category_labels <- c(
  "0-2",
  "3-10",
  "11-30",
  "31-183",
  "184-365",
  "366-730",
  "731-1094",
  "1095+"
)

category_table <- data.frame(
  Category = 1:8,
  DaysAtLarge = category_labels
)

kbl(
  category_table,
  caption = "Days at Large Category Definitions",
  col.names = c("Category", "Days at Large")
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
    full_width = FALSE
  )

SummaryTable <- TagReturns %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  summarise(
    AverageDaysAtLarge = round(mean(daysAtLarge, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    MinimumDaysAtLarge = min(daysAtLarge, na.rm = TRUE),
    MaximumDaysAtLarge = max(daysAtLarge, na.rm = TRUE),
    Abundance = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(category)

kbl(
  SummaryTable,
  col.names = c(
    "Category",
    "Average Days at Large",
    "Minimum Days",
    "Maximum Days",
    "Number of Returns"
  ),
  align = "c"
) %>%
  kable_paper("striped", full_width = FALSE)

TagReturns <- TagReturns %>%
  mutate(
    category = factor(
      category,
      levels = 1:8,
      labels = category_labels,
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

SummaryTable <- TagReturns %>%
  group_by(
    Ground,
    returnedArea,
    category
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    TotalReturns = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```


## Category by Year

```{r Returns by Year, echo = FALSE}



returns_by_year <- TagReturns %>%
  mutate(
    return_year = year(returnedDate)
  ) %>%
  count(
    return_year,
    category
  )

year_category_table <- as.data.frame(
  table(
    Year = year(TagReturns$returnedDate),
    Category = TagReturns$category
  )
)

year_category_table %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Category,
    values_from = Freq,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  kbl(
    caption = "Tag Returns by Year and Days-at-Large Category",
    align = "c"
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c(
      "striped",
      "hover",
      "condensed",
      "responsive"
    ),
    full_width = FALSE
  ) %>%
  row_spec(
    0,
    bold = TRUE,
    color = "white",
    background = "#2C3E50"
  )

ggplot(
  year_category_table,
  aes(
    x = Category,
    y = Freq,
    fill = factor(Year)
  )
) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Tag Returns by Category and Return Year",
    x = "Days at Large Category",
    y = "Number of Returns",
    fill = "Return Year"
  )
```

## Individual Grounds Return Summaries {.tabset}

```{r Individual Grounds, results='asis', echo=FALSE}

grounds <- TagReturns %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Ground),
    Ground != ""
  ) %>%
  pull(Ground) %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()


for (g in grounds) {

  cat(paste0("\n\n### ", g, "\n\n"))

  p <- TagReturns %>%
    filter(Ground == g) %>%
    ggplot(
      aes(
        x = returnedArea,
        fill = category
      )
    ) +
    geom_bar() +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = paste("Returns from", g),
      x = "Return Area",
      y = "Number of Returns",
      fill = "Days at Large"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1
      )
    )

  print(p)

  print(
    kbl(
      SummaryTable %>%
        filter(Ground == g) %>%
        arrange(returnedArea, category),
      caption = paste("Return Summary for", g)
    ) %>%
      kable_paper(
        "striped",
        full_width = FALSE
      )
  )

  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## Three Return Group Summary {.tabset}

```{r Three Group Summary, results='asis', echo=FALSE}

ThreeGroupSummary <- TagReturns %>%
  mutate(
    ReturnGroup = case_when(

      returnedArea == "Scots Bay" ~ "Scots Bay",

      returnedArea %in% c(
        "German Bank",
        "Seal Island"
      ) ~ "German Bank/Seal Island",

      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# Summary table
ThreeGroupTable <- ThreeGroupSummary %>%
  group_by(
    Ground,
    ReturnGroup,
    category
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    TotalReturns = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ThreeGroupTableWide <- ThreeGroupTable %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = category,
    values_from = TotalReturns,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    TotalTags = rowSums(
      select(
        .,
        -Ground,
        -ReturnGroup
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  relocate(
    TotalTags,
    .after = ReturnGroup
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    Ground,
    ReturnGroup
  )

grounds <- ThreeGroupSummary %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Ground),
    Ground != ""
  ) %>%
  pull(Ground) %>%
  unique() %>%
  sort()

for(g in grounds){

  cat(
    paste0(
      "\n\n### ",
      g,
      "\n\n"
    )
  )


  p <- ThreeGroupSummary %>%
    filter(Ground == g) %>%
    ggplot(
      aes(
        x = ReturnGroup,
        fill = as.factor(category)
      )
    ) +
    geom_bar() +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Three Return Groups -",
        g
      ),
      x = "Return Group",
      y = "Number of Returns",
      fill = "Category"
    )

print(p)

  print(

    kbl(
      ThreeGroupTableWide %>%
        filter(
          Ground == g
        ),
      caption = paste(
        "Three Group Summary for",
        g
      )
    ) %>%

      kable_paper(
        "striped",
        full_width = FALSE
      )

  )

  cat("\n\n")

}
```
